author: Cas van de Pol
description:
GNOME SHOW MERCH: https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/cas-van-de-pol

After spotting a beautiful tower in the distance, the old fashioned gnome Willem enters New Gnome City for the first time in his life. He’s hoping to find tools to make his own house a little bit more… impressive.
